title: Material Wizard
pageTitle: Material Wizard - PBR materials for BeamNG
tagline: A tool to create PBR materials for BeamNG. Photos are not uploaded to the server.
drop: Click, drop or paste a photo to start.
splitTip: Drag to make the preview wider or narrower. Double-click to reset.
zoomTip: Scroll over the picture to zoom. Drag to move it. Double-click to reset.

presets.name: preset name
presets.tip: Load a saved preset. The photo and the material name stay as they are.
presets.saveTip: Save the current settings under this name. Saving an existing name replaces it.

maps.title: maps
maps.intro: Start with a photo. Every map is generated from it unless you load your own or set a flat value. A loaded height or normal feeds the maps that depend on it. Click a thumbnail to view it large.
maps.previewSizeTip: Maps are worked on at this size while you edit, to save GPU memory.
maps.shapeTip: Power-of-two photos keep their own ratio. Auto detects it.
maps.orm: ORM (R ao, G rough, B metal)
maps.rma: RMA (R rough, G metal, B ao)
maps.lightsNote: 3 to 8 photos from a fixed camera, each with its own light direction. Solves albedo and a normal. For a scan you lit yourself.

tile.title: tile
tile.intro: Drag the orange frame on the photo to pick the tile, and drag a corner to resize it. Click the small square, or switch to tile repeated above the picture, to check the seams.
tile.zoomTip: Scroll to zoom. Drag empty space, or the right mouse button, to move the picture. Double-click to reset.
tile.highlightTip: Show or hide this edge's colour, so you can see the blend.
tile.edgesNote: An edge that is on gets covered with the photo from the dashed area past the opposite edge, so it matches when the tile repeats. One edge per direction is usually enough. With both on, each covers at half strength.
tile.fitTip: Make the frame as big as the photo allows, leaving room for the sides that are on
tile.fixNote: While this is open, the big view shows the whole photo, so you can fix it before you pick the tile.
tile.rotateNote: Turn the photo until the lines in it follow the grid. Drag on the picture or use the slider. The picture is zoomed in a little, so no empty corners are left.
tile.quadNote: Photographed at an angle? Drag the four corners onto something that should be a rectangle, like a paving slab or the edges of a road. The small view shows the result.

shape.title: shape
shape.flip: DirectX normal (flip Y). BeamNG wants this off.
shape.detailNote: For a soft photoscan bake: load the baked normal, then add fine detail from the photo on top of it.
shape.addDetail: Add detail to the loaded normal
shape.detailAuto: Match the amount to how soft the bake is
shape.flatOnly: Only where the bake is flat
shape.mapDetailNote: For loaded AO, roughness or metallic maps: the fine detail of the generated map is added on top of yours.
shape.mapDetailAo: Add detail to the loaded AO
shape.mapDetailRough: Add detail to the loaded roughness
shape.mapDetailMetal: Add detail to the loaded metallic

surface.title: surface
surface.metalNote: Each region gets its own value, set from its material class and free to change. Use Flat on the Metallic map for one value everywhere.

preview.title: preview
preview.note: Opens the lit view. Drag to turn the shape, Shift-drag or the right button to move the sun, scroll to zoom. Double-click resets the turn and the zoom. Middle-drag pans while zoomed in.
preview.hint: Drag turns the shape. Shift-drag or right-drag moves the sun. Scroll zooms. Double-click resets.
preview.zoomTip: Scroll to zoom out or in. Double-click resets.

export.title: export
export.name: Material name
export.nameNote: The name comes from the photo you open. It names the zip and every saved map.
export.saveNote: Save one map as a PNG:
export.sizeNote: Used only when you save a map or the zip. The preview stays at the preview size.
export.batchNote: Point at a folder. Each photo becomes a material with the settings on screen. A base color plus a matching normal is treated as a baked set.

notes.stretch: Image aspect is far from the working size, so it is being stretched.
notes.resampled: {name} was resampled to the working size.
notes.road: Road width {width} m across the image. Set textureLength to {length} in the editor. Roughness {rough}, metallic {metal}.
notes.seam: Seams: left to right {x}, top to bottom {y}.
notes.tileMargin: Not enough photo beyond the frame for: {sides}. Move the frame, make it smaller or use Fit frame.
notes.repeat: Repeat about {x} x {y} px. Crop {w} x {h}.
notes.lengthFile: Set the road textureLength to {length} meters. Overlays need a higher renderPriority than the base road, set on the road in the editor.
notes.objectSpace: Loaded normal looks object-space. This tool expects a tangent-space normal.
notes.gpuCap: The photo is {w} x {h}. Previewing at {sw} x {sh} so it fits in GPU memory.
notes.gpuOom: The GPU ran out of memory at {size} px. Working at up to {cap} px instead.
notes.exportCap: Saved maps are {sw} x {sh}. The full size is {w} x {h}. Pick 8192 under Output size to try it.
notes.gpuLost: The GPU ran out of memory and reset. Retrying at a smaller size.
